title: Run the Jenkins pipeline harness in required checks
body:
Outcome: infra/ci/jenkins/tests/pipeline_test.groovy (the only executable check of ownedCi.groovy and Controller stubs) runs in npm run preflight or krn/gate with an exact mise-pinned Java (temurin-11.0.32+101 works) and a SHA256-verified groovy-all-2.4.21.jar (de65260cf2070442e99882f2f3d72e7531725c1e6a257446cc0cea525c607bd0), so a Groovy regression fails CI instead of relying on a lead running it by hand. Evidence: PR #182 needed a manual jar download and java install; red/green proof lives only in .krn/runs/lead/gate-infra-rerun/groovy-*.out.
Proof: a deliberately broken ownedCi.groovy assertion makes the chosen gate step fail; the step passes on main.
